claims.claim_text: Newport News is the prime contractor on the Gerald R. Ford class (CVN 78) aircraft carriers, with $15.4B in awarded contract value for CVN 80 (Enterprise) and CVN 81 (Doris Miller), and FY 2026 NDAA authorization for CVN 82 (William J. Clinton) and CVN 83 (George W. Bush) including incremental funding/advance procurement.

claims.predicate: is prime / is awarded contracts on

claims.source_quote: we have received contract awards valued at $15.4 billion for detail design and construction of the Gerald R. Ford class (CVN 78) aircraft carriers, Enterprise (CVN 80) and Doris Miller (CVN 81)... The fiscal year 2026 National Defense Authorization Act ('NDAA') provides authorization for William J. claims.claim_text: HII Newport News, in teaming with Electric Boat (General Dynamics), is building Virginia class (SSN 774) fast attack submarines at a two-per-year rate; Block IV (10 boats), Block V (12 boats including added boats from 2023/2025 contract modifications), and advance procurement for all ten Block VI boats has been received.
claims.subject: HII Newport News
claims.predicate: is building (teaming) / received advance procurement on
claims.object_value: Virginia class SSN 774 Blocks IV/V/VI; 2 boats per year production rate
claims.source_quote: We have a teaming agreement with Electric Boat Corporation... to build Virginia class (SSN 774) fast attack nuclear submarines... In 2023, 2024 and 2025, the team received contract awards for advance procurement of long-lead-time material in support of all ten Block VI boats.

claims.claim_text: HII Newport News, as a subcontractor to Electric Boat, is participating in the Columbia class (SSBN 826) ballistic missile submarine program; 12 boats are anticipated, with Build II (5 additional boats) under long-lead-time material contract.
claims.subject: HII Newport News
claims.object_value: Columbia class SSBN 826; 12 boats planned; Build II of 5 additional boats under LLTM contract
claims.source_quote: As a subcontractor to Electric Boat, we leverage our Virginia class (SSN 774) experience to perform design work and build modules for the entire Columbia class (SSBN 826) submarine program... In 2023, we were awarded a contract modification for long-lead-time material and advance construction in support of five additional Columbia class (SSBN 826) boats, also referred to as Build II of the class.

claims.claim_text: HII Ingalls is the sole builder of U.S. Navy amphibious assault ships (LHA / LPD); currently constructing LHA 8 Bougainville, LHA 9 Fallujah, LHA 10 Helmand Province, and LPD 30/31/32 with multi-ship procurement contract awarded for LPD 33/34/35 in 2024.
claims.subject: HII Ingalls
claims.source_quote: We are the sole builder of amphibious assault ships and one of two builders of surface combatants for the U.S. Navy... in 2024, we were awarded a contract modification for the detail design and construction of Helmand Province (LHA 10)... In 2024, we were awarded a multi-ship procurement contract for the construction of Travis Manion (LPD 33), LPD 34 (unnamed), and LPD 35 (unnamed).

claims.claim_text: HII Ingalls is one of two builders of Arleigh Burke class (DDG 51) guided-missile destroyers, with multi-year contracts for 6 (2018) + 1 (2020) + 6 + option (2023, totaling 7 ships) currently in construction (DDG 129/131/133/135).
claims.subject: HII Ingalls
claims.predicate: is awarded multi-year construction contracts on
claims.object_value: Arleigh Burke DDG-51 class; multi-year award for 7 ships (2023) plus earlier MYP for 7 ships
claims.source_quote: We have delivered 36 Arleigh Burke class (DDG 51) destroyers to the U.S. Navy... In 2023, we were awarded a multi-year contract for construction of six more Arleigh Burke class (DDG 51) destroyers, as well as the first option ship, for a total of seven ships.

claims.claim_text: HII is the exclusive prime contractor for U.S. Navy nuclear aircraft carrier Refueling and Complex Overhaul (RCOH); currently performing RCOH of USS John C. Stennis (CVN 74) after redelivering USS George Washington (CVN 73) in 2023.
claims.subject: HII Newport News
claims.object_value: CVN RCOH program; CVN 74 Stennis ongoing; future RCOH on Nimitz class and Ford class
claims.source_quote: We continue to be the exclusive prime contractor for nuclear aircraft carrier refueling and complex overhaul ('RCOH')... we are currently performing the RCOH of USS John C. Stennis (CVN 74).

claims.claim_text: Approximately 81% of HII's 2025 revenues were generated from the U.S. Navy (vs. 80% in 2024 and 81% in 2023) - extreme single-customer concentration on Navy SCN/SCN-adjacent programs.
claims.subject: HII (consolidated)
claims.source_quote: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, approximately 81%, 80%, and 81%, respectively, of our revenues were generated from the U.S. Navy.

claims.claim_text: HII Ingalls is winding down its Legend class National Security Cutter (NSC) program for the U.S. Coast Guard; in 2025, HII reached agreement with the Coast Guard to terminate production and delivery of the 11th and final ship.

claims.claim_text: HII Mission Technologies segment provides C5ISR, AI/ML, cyber, unmanned underwater/surface vessels, and live-virtual-constructive training to DoD, intelligence community, and DoE customers - including DoE national security mission management.
claims.subject: HII Mission Technologies
claims.object_value: DoD/IC/DoE customers; C5ISR, cyber, unmanned, LVC training, DoE site management
claims.source_quote: Our Mission Technologies segment provides a wide range of services and products, including command, control, computers, communications, cyber, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance ('C5ISR') systems and operations; the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning to battlefield decisions; defense and offensive cyberspace strategies and electronic warfare; unmanned autonomous systems...

claims.claim_text: HII employs over 44,000 people domestically and internationally across Ingalls (Pascagoula, MS - 800 acres) and Newport News (550 acres, James River, VA) shipyards.
claims.subject: HII
claims.object_value: Pascagoula MS shipyard (800 ac); Newport News VA shipyard (550 ac); ~44,000 employees
claims.source_quote: Headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, we employ over 44,000 people domestically and internationally... Our Ingalls segment is located in Pascagoula, Mississippi on 800 acres along the Pascagoula River... Our Newport News shipyard is located on approximately 550 acres near the mouth of the James River.

claims.claim_text: HII discloses extensive U.S. Government counterparty relationships (U.S. Navy SUPSHIP, DCAA, DCMA audits) and that the Navy oversees and audits HII's contract performance, cost structure, and business systems.
claims.subject: HII
claims.source_quote: We are overseen and audited by the U.S. Government and its agencies, including the U.S. Navy's Supervisor of Shipbuilding, the Defense Contract Audit Agency ('DCAA'), and the Defense Contract Management Agency ('DCMA').
